title: Feature Request: Better Data Stream Support for RAG & Agentic Applications

linked_prs.title: feat (ai/core): reworked data stream management
linked_prs.body:
Fixes #3900 

## Background

The current `StreamData` approach relies on using `streamText` to create the response. However, this means custom data cannot be sent  before `streamText` is called - and this is often necessary in RAG or agentic applications. This PR changes the custom data approach to using a callback that immediately returns. A `DataStreamWriter` is exposed inside the callback to send custom data to the stream.
